description: Test file for the agentfield-server command in the control plane project. Contains unit tests for configuration loading, UI building, server start-up, and browser automation.

methods.name: TestLoadConfig_DefaultsApplied
methods.description: Tests that loading configuration with defaults applies the expected default values.

methods.name: TestLoadConfig_ConfigFileValues
methods.description: Tests configuration loading from a file, ensuring values are correctly read.

methods.name: TestLoadConfig_VCRequirementsFromConfigFile
methods.description: Verifies VC requirements are correctly loaded from the config file.

methods.name: TestBuildUI_SkipsWhenPackageJSONMissing
methods.description: Ensures buildUI skips execution when package.json is missing.

methods.name: TestBuildUI_RunsInstallAndBuild
methods.description: Checks that buildUI runs 'npm install' and 'npm run build' with correct environment.

methods.name: TestBuildUI_CommandError
methods.description: Validates error handling when build commands fail.

methods.name: TestRunServer_AppliesFlagOverrides
methods.description: Ensures command-line flags override configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: TestRunServer_OpensBrowserForDevUI
methods.description: Tests that the dev UI mode opens the correct URL in the browser.

methods.name: TestOpenBrowserUsesLauncher
methods.description: Verifies that the browser launcher function is invoked correctly based on OS.
